gap_model.cost: believed difficulty = true * F (over) or true / F (under); in the mixed arm the direction is drawn once per obstacle and held across the whole ladder
gap_model.risk: believed level = true level shifted K steps toward safe (under) or dangerous (over), clipped to the ladder
gap_model.scoring: C_true re-prices the risk surcharge at the reference level, so a run that under-called risk does not get a discount for it
